nodes.description: Percentage tax fee redistributed to holders, read by calculateTaxFee and written by setFees/removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
Marketing fee percentage applied to transfers, read by calculateMarketingFee and mutated by setFees/removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
Maximum allowed transfer amount, enforced in _transfer and changeable by _setMaxTxAmount.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers SwapAndSend, settable by setnumTokensToExchangeForMarketing.
Payable marketing wallet receiving ETH proceeds of the swap; target of marketingWallet.transfer and _setMarketingWallet.
Reflection balances mapping adjusted by internal transfer routines.
Token balances for excluded accounts mapping adjusted by internal transfer routines.
Mapping deciding whether an account pays transfer fees; checked in _transfer.
Total reflections supply reduced inside _reflectFee.
Immutable uniswap pair address used to detect sells in setFees and to avoid self-swap in _transfer.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap around SwapAndSend.
Global switch controlling whether automatic swap-and-send executes, settable by setSwapAndSendEnabled.
Flag controlling whether per-transfer fee recalculation via setFees is applied.
Default marketing fee percentage restored by setFees, settable by setDefaultMarketingFee.
Higher marketing fee applied on sell transactions, read by setFees and settable by setMarketingFee4Sellers.
Accumulated total fees tracked by _reflectFee.
Core private transfer routine enforcing limits, triggering SwapAndSend, setting fees and delegating to _tokenTransfer.
Dispatcher that routes transfers to the correct excluded/non-excluded variant and toggles fee removal.
Swaps accumulated contract tokens for ETH via the uniswap router and forwards ETH to the marketing wallet, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Recomputes _taxFee and _marketingFee, applying the seller fee when the recipient is the uniswap pair.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point invoking _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom entry point invoking _transfer and reducing allowance.
Public ERC20 approve entry point writing _allowances via _approve.
Standard reflection transfer routine for non-excluded sender and recipient.
Credits marketing fee tokens to the contract address in reflection and token balances.
Reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee and increases _tFeeTotal using arithmetic sub/add.
Computes token and reflection amounts by combining _getTValues and _getRValues with the current rate.
Computes holder tax fee as amount * _taxFee / 100.
Computes marketing fee as amount * _marketingFee / 100.
Owner-only setter for the marketing wallet address.
Owner-only setter for the maximum transaction amount.
Owner-only toggle of the automatic swap-and-send switch.
Owner-only setter for the swap trigger threshold.
Transfer routine for non-excluded sender to excluded recipient.
Transfer routine for excluded sender to non-excluded recipient.
Transfer routine when both sender and recipient are excluded.
Attacker-controlled caller address used as sender in transfer/approve/transferFrom flows.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the uniswap swap deadline in SwapAndSend.
External call to the uniswap V2 router that swaps tokens for ETH and can hand control to external contracts.
ETH transfer to the marketing wallet address, an external value transfer that can invoke a receive fallback.
Chain of mul/div/sub operations computing reflection and token fee amounts in _getRValues and _reflectFee.
Internal allowance write performed by _approve granting the router or spender spending rights.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer.
Local holding the contract token balance used to trigger and size the SwapAndSend call.
Local boolean deciding whether fees are deducted inside _tokenTransfer.
Local swap path array passed to the uniswap router swap call.
Local ETH balance read from address(this).balance and forwarded to the marketing wallet.

edges.reason: transfer() invokes _transfer with the caller address.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer before reducing the allowance.
_transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer conditionally triggers SwapAndSend when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer calls setFees to recalculate fees on each transfer.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferToExcluded when only the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferFromExcluded when only the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferBothExcluded when both accounts are excluded.
SwapAndSend approves the router to spend the contract tokens before swapping.
SwapAndSend calls the uniswap router swap entry point.
SwapAndSend forwards the resulting ETH balance to the marketing wallet.
_getValues obtains the tax fee through calculateTaxFee.
_getValues obtains the marketing fee through calculateMarketingFee.
_transferStandard credits marketing tokens via _takeMarketing.
_transferStandard updates reflection accounting via _reflectFee.
_reflectFee performs unchecked-style reflection arithmetic on the total supply.
msg.sender becomes the sender argument used by transfer().
msg.sender is used as the spender when reducing allowance in transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as the owner allowance key in approve().
msg.sender is passed as the from parameter into _transfer.
The from parameter drives the transfer origin checks and balance updates.
The to parameter drives the transfer destination checks and balance updates.
The amount parameter flows into the max transaction check and balance math.
_maxTxAmount is read to enforce the transfer limit in _transfer.
numTokensToExchangeForMarketing is compared against the contract balance in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against the sender to avoid circular swaps.
inSwapAndSend guard is read to prevent nested SwapAndSend calls.
SwapAndSendEnabled gates the automatic swap in _transfer.
feesOnSellersAndBuyers gates the setFees call in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether fees are removed for the transfer.
defaultMarketingFee is applied as the marketing fee by setFees.
_marketingFee4Sellers is applied on sells by setFees.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against the recipient to detect sells in setFees.
_taxFee is multiplied into the tax fee computation.
_marketingFee is multiplied into the marketing fee computation.
_rTotal is reduced by the reflection fee.
_tFeeTotal is increased by the token fee.
_rOwned balances are mutated by the standard transfer routine.
_tOwned balances are mutated by the excluded transfer routines.
marketingWallet receives the ETH transferred after the swap.
_setMarketingWallet overwrites the marketing wallet state variable.
_setMaxTxAmount overwrites the max transaction amount.
setnumTokensToExchangeForMarketing overwrites the swap threshold.
setSwapAndSendEnabled overwrites the swap switch.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, making execution miner-influenced.
SwapAndSend reads block.timestamp for the router deadline parameter.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap input amount to SwapAndSend.
takeFee is passed into _tokenTransfer to control fee removal.
path array is passed to the external swap call.
contractETHBalance is the amount forwarded to the marketing wallet.
The external uniswap swap can re-enter the contract while SwapAndSend has not finished its state updates.
Sending ETH to an arbitrary marketing wallet can execute a fallback and re-enter before the swap flag is cleared.
External swap invoked inside the transfer flow allows re-entering _transfer before balances are finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter that only exists to feed the _transfer routine and has no standalone security meaning.
to is a parameter consumed exclusively by _transfer for recipient checks and balance updates.
amount is a parameter used solely inside _transfer for limit checks and arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance is the local value forwarded to the SwapAndSend swap call.
takeFee is the local flag passed into _tokenTransfer to govern fee removal.
path is the local array argument supplied directly to the external uniswap swap operation.
contractETHBalance is the local value moved by the ETH transfer to the marketing wallet.
